title: Young Criminal Attacks Woman and Loses It During Arrest
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 21st, 2023. Officers received a 911 call in regards to a woman who had just assaulted & robbed another woman. The victim said the assailant asked for food and said no which caused her to start assaulting the victim. When officers finally caught up to her, the assailant was heavily intoxicated and kept asking why she was being placed under arrest. Officers tried questioning her but she did not make any sense. When a search was conducted on her, she started to act irrationally, saying she did not want a female officer to search her because she had been r*ped by her mom & when officers tried placing her in the vehicle, she said to resist and kick officers.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
